summary: The agent informed the caller that a power of attorney document is required to discuss the account. The customer, calling on behalf of her mother who had a stroke, said she has the POA and asked where to send it. The agent directed her to email legal@crestview.com and noted verification takes about 48 hours before a hardship payment can be arranged. The customer agreed to email the documents and requested a pause on collection calls.
